reuse.why: Adds the rule to the existing isMonthWideCategory predicate that every month-wide action already calls, and detects the tag with the existing shared extractTagsFromText helper.

duplication.why: The rule is written once; only the notes join and group_notes column are repeated in the three queries the tree already keeps separately (getBudgetData, getAverageCategories, setZero).

placement.why: The exclusion lives in the MonthWideCategory predicate and its type/comment in budget/actions.ts, where the other exclusions already are.

scope.why: Only the predicate, the queries that feed it, the comment and a test change.

maintainability.why: One predicate documents and applies all exclusions, and tag parsing is consistent with the rest of the app.

one_place.where: isMonthWideCategory in budget/actions.ts, used by copyPreviousMonth, setZero, setLastMonthSpending and the 3/6/12-month average actions.
